notes: Identical mounts to index.config.json on purpose: validates in minutes exactly the environment the full performance benchmark will see (GPU/torch, HF token presence, test-tar mount + extraction, model download, a mini measurement pass).

slug=null -> the kaggle service runner derives the kernel name: <model>-<type> for index, <model>-<type>-<name> otherwise. Kernels live in a Kaggle collection named after the model (maintained in the UI — the API has no collections endpoint).
